queries.prompt: Starlink satellites over United States right now
queries.sql:
-- Geo-query: propagated positions at current UTC time
SELECT norad_cat_id FROM satellites WHERE name LIKE '%STARLINK%' BOUNDING BOX lat=[24.39, 49.38] lon=[-125.0, -66.93]

queries.prompt: Show me Starlink satellites with inclination greater than 53
queries.sql: SELECT s.norad_cat_id FROM satellites s JOIN tle_elements t ON s.id = t.satellite_id WHERE s.name LIKE '%STARLINK%' AND t.inclination_deg > 53 LIMIT 50;

queries.prompt: Satellites with mean motion greater than 15 rev/day
queries.sql: SELECT s.norad_cat_id FROM satellites s JOIN tle_elements t ON s.id = t.satellite_id WHERE t.mean_motion_rev_day > 15 LIMIT 50;

queries.prompt: Satellites with inclination greater than 95 degrees
queries.sql: SELECT s.norad_cat_id FROM satellites s JOIN tle_elements t ON s.id = t.satellite_id WHERE t.inclination_deg > 95 LIMIT 50;

queries.prompt: Satellites in polar orbit with inclination near 90 degrees
queries.sql: SELECT s.norad_cat_id FROM satellites s JOIN tle_elements t ON s.id = t.satellite_id WHERE t.inclination_deg BETWEEN 85 AND 95 LIMIT 50;

queries.prompt: Satellites with high orbital eccentricity greater than 0.01
queries.sql: SELECT s.norad_cat_id FROM satellites s JOIN tle_elements t ON s.id = t.satellite_id WHERE t.eccentricity > 0.01 LIMIT 50;

queries.prompt: Find ISS or Space Station satellites
queries.sql: SELECT s.norad_cat_id FROM satellites s WHERE s.name LIKE '%ISS%' OR s.name LIKE '%ZARYA%' OR s.name LIKE '%STATION%' LIMIT 50;

queries.prompt: GPS satellites over the United States
queries.sql:
-- Geo-query: propagated positions at current UTC time
SELECT norad_cat_id FROM satellites WHERE (name LIKE '%GPS%' OR name LIKE '%NAVSTAR%') BOUNDING BOX lat=[24.39, 49.38] lon=[-125.0, -66.93]
SELECT norad_cat_id FROM satellites WHERE name LIKE '%Starlink%' LIMIT 5
